sloka: सुमालेरनुजस्तस्यां जनयामास यत् प्रभो ।अपत्यं कथ्यमानं तु मया त्वं शृणु राघव ।। ७.५.४३ ॥
transliteration: sumāleranujastasyāṁ janayāmāsa yat prabho ।apatyaṁ kathyamānaṁ tu mayā tvaṁ śṛṇu rāghava ।। 7.5.43 ॥

translations.english: O Lord Raghava, listen to the offspring that Sumali's younger brother begot in her, which I am now relating to you.
